messages:
Matt (Support): FYI escalating an onboarding blocker for customer PerchAI - they hit a 403 on model provisioning when requesting dedicated capacity. Pilot users blocked, renewal in ~3w. Ticket #8765. @Anya @Julie can you take?
Anya (CS Lead): Ack - marking P1 for CS priority. Need impact, workaround (if any), and timeline from Support.
Matt (Support): Impact: 5 pilot seats cannot complete setup (QA/test env). No workaround found. Error snippet:
``
POST /v1/deployments/provision
403 Forbidden
{"error":"quota_exceeded","quota":"dedicated_gpu"}
```
Also seeing header: `X-Request-ID: rq_0a1b2c3d`. Customer contact: sara@perch.ai.
Julie (CSE): I'll own the customer comms and run the bridge. Proposed comms plan: 1) immediate email acknowledging escalation + ETA; 2) 30-min triage call today; 3) offer short-term hosted fallback if we can open host slot. Need infra to bump quota or route to hosted. @Priya can you draft fallback wording? @Liz pls standby for renewal note.
Priya (Solutions): Happy to draft fallback and technical steps. Ask Support for tenant_id and full request_id. Suggested fallback blurb: "We can temporarily route your pilot to a hosted instance while we resolve provisioning - this avoids downtime for your testers."
Sam (Onboarding): I can schedule a call - available 15:30 or 17:00 PT today. Which works for PerchAI?
Matt (Support): Adding tenant: tenant-perchai-87, full request id: rq_0a1b2c3d-9e. Support ticket link: https://redwood.support/tickets/8765. Repro script we used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/deployments/provision \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-ded-4x","tenant":"tenant-perchai-87"}'
```
Julie (CSE): Draft email (sending for review):
"Hi Sara - we're escalating this to our CS team as a priority. We're scheduling a short call to remediate; temporary hosted routing is an option so your testers can continue. Will confirm time in next 30m. - Julie, Customer Success"
Anya (CS Lead): Comms plan approved. Owner: Julie for customer contact + call. Owner: Priya for fallback wording and technical ops. Support to own infra escalation for quota bump. Sam to confirm call slot and send invite. Liz to monitor renewal communications and join if risk surfaces.
Liz (Renewals): On watch - if this stretches >1 week flag renewal rep so we can prioritize contract conversation. I'll join the call if it's during EMEA hours.
Matt (Support): Filed infra escalation with eng-infra (pinged @eng-infra). Adding logs/headers to ticket.
Julie (CSE): I'll send the email now and draft the invite for 17:00 PT. Will post the sent copy here.
Anya (CS Lead): Thanks team. Please add any post-call next steps to the ticket (#8765) and mention when fallback is activated. :thumbsup:
Matt (Support): Thanks everyone - updating ticket and closing loop in 2h with status update. :white_check_mark:
